introHtml: Kraft material gives your branded lunch bags, boxes, and totes a natural, eco-conscious look that stands out from standard white or plastic options. The brown kraft paper surface provides excellent contrast for screen-printed logos, and its sturdy construction handles everyday use. Ideal for corporate sustainability initiatives, trade show giveaways, or retail packaging, these kraft items convey a down-to-earth brand image while remaining fully customizable with your company name or design.
